reuse.why: Keeps using link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, and folds the five provider copies into one linkBankAccount path that every provider now reuses.

duplication.why: Removes the five near-identical upsert/sync blocks instead of adding a sixth copy of the guard; the new check exists once.

placement.why: The guard and shared link flow sit in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers, though a db-level query helper could arguably live with other account queries.

scope.why: Delivers the guard, but also does a large unrequested consolidation of all provider link functions, which widens the review surface well beyond the request, and adds no tests.

maintainability.why: One link pipeline is easier to own, but typing is loosened (newAccount: Record<string, unknown>, `as string` cast on bankKey, Partial overrides via `extra`).

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five provider handlers go through linkBankAccount, which calls assertBankAccountNotLinked first.

disguised_duplication.where: Former copies are actually removed and shared via linkBankAccount/linkExternalAccount.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked, called once at the top of linkBankAccount, which every provider link function uses.
